# ChunkMap

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

Chunk coordinates to chunk entity

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `chunks` | `std::unordered_map<glm::ivec3, entt::entity, IVec3Hash>` | the chunks in range; get(pos) gives entt::null when absent |

## Notes

Emplaced and maintained by ChunkManager; looked up by TerrainColliders and the other terrain users.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: TerrainColliders, WorldTerrain. Written by: ChunkManager. Created by: ChunkManager. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [ChunkManager](../systems/ChunkManager.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | preinit | emplaced empty |
| [ChunkManager](../systems/ChunkManager.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | chunks added on load, erased on unload |
| [TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (makeJob) | the chunk entity of a cell, when streamed |
| [WorldTerrain](../systems/WorldTerrain.md) | system | World | **read** | tick (makeJob) | looked up, absent in worlds: cells sample the generator |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ChunkManager](../systems/ChunkManager.md)**
  - Creates one entity per chunk coming into range; never destroys (TerrainSys destroys ChunkDestroying chunks).
- **[TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in sorted cell order (deterministic).
  - Taskflow for_each (waited) over new required cells and silent_async prefetch jobs; zone Build collider cell.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit (throws when missing).
  - Log warning 'Terrain collider : ...' when Jolt refuses a mesh.
- **[WorldTerrain](../systems/WorldTerrain.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in the world's PhysicsWorld, in sorted cell order.
  - CPU marching cubes and FastNoise2 sampling on the world's thread.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit; log warning on a refused mesh.
